steps.note: Open the prepared live auction with Vendor A's existing bid while keeping the buyer session available.

Open the live auction's pricing round where the existing bid can be revised.
Submit the revised bid, replacing Vendor A's previous price of 100 with 110.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the revised submission.
Return to the buyer's event page to verify the updated bid.
Open the buyer's Responses view for the auction.
Confirm the buyer sees Vendor A's direct response after the revision.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Verify the buyer-side comparison grid shows the revised price of 110.
Verify the forward-auction ranking reflects the updated bid under the highest-price ranking order.
